item.title: Roshumba Williams attends 'Project Runway' winner Veejay Floresca's NYFW show
item.description: Fashion expert Roshumba Williams is teaming up with designer Veejay Floresca for a custom look at this year's Academy Awards. Go inside Floresca's inclusive NYFW debut and see how she's preparing for Hollywood's biggest night. Don't miss "The Oscars" Sunday, March 15 on ABC and Hulu.

item.title: NJ Transit resumes weekday schedule Wednesday, train service on Portal Bridge cutover schedule
item.description: NJ Transit announced that Light Rail, Bus and Access Link service will operate on a full weekday schedule on Wednesday.

item.title: Court says the IRS can continue to share immigrants' taxpayer data with ICE
item.description: A federal court on Tuesday rejected a request from an immigrant rights group to temporarily block the IRS from sharing certain taxpayer data.

item.title: 67-year-old woman grateful to shoveling 'snow angels' after historic blizzard
item.description: A group of "snow angels" in Westchester County helps older adults and people with disabilities to shovel after snowstorms, big and small.

item.title: Mamdani, AOC team up to encourage New Yorkers to sign up for 3-K, Pre-K as deadline approaches
item.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez teamed up to encourage parents to sign up for 3-K or Pre-K by this Friday's deadline.

item.title: NYC Public Schools reopen after historic blizzard with only 63% attendance rate
item.description: New York City Public Schools reopened for in-person learning on Tuesday, but there was only a 63% attendance rate among students, according to the schools chancellor.

item.title: Houlihan's in Secaucus evacuated after ceiling buckles from snow on the roof
item.description: The ceiling inside a Houlihan's in Secaucus was found to be buckling under the weight of the snow on the flat roof.

item.title: Crews face uphill battle digging out Staten Island, NYC's hardest-hit borough from blizzard
item.description: New York City was absolutely thumped by the winter blizzard, including the hardest-hit borough of Staten Island, which topped out at 29 inches of snow in some areas.

item.title: Takeaways from Trump's State of the Union address: Sales mode on economy, heavy on patriotism
item.description: President Trump used his State of the Union address to sell a booming America, even as voters worry about the economy.

item.title: NYPD releases images of 4 people wanted for questioning after officers hit with snowballs
item.description: The NYPD has released images of four people they are looking to question after several NYPD officers were hit with snowballs and injured on Monday.
